Reviewer Protocol

  1. Inspect the high-resolution specimen or object photo in the left column.
  2. Verify whether the image depicts a butterfly or obvious non-biological crawler junk (e.g. electric guitars, envelopes, banner graphics).
  3. For genuine butterflies (*Graphium* or *Athyma*), select UNCERTAIN or NEEDS_TAXONOMIST unless you can definitively assign the species.
  4. Save decisions into reports/phase3/mega_cluster_review.csv, then run .venv/bin/python pipeline/tools/validate_phase3_review.py.
